name: Ikeda (Fukui, Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Ikeda town emblem in white: a ring with a curved stroke rising to the upper fly, like a stylised numeral 6.
history: Municipal flag of Ikeda, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 September 1964.

features.role: Ikeda town emblem — a ring with a curved stroke rising to the upper fly, like a stylised numeral 6
